findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed that the PIC does not currently have a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) certificate. No one on staff has a CFPM. Staff only have Certified Food Handler cards. Medium Risk establishments must have a CFPM present in the establishment when food preparation is happening. Inspector will return for Spot Check to confirm that establishment has a CFPM present during food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Observed fresh produce (whole onions, halved and whole green peppers) had split and/or spilled in the walk-in cooler and were on the floor, and had rolled to various places. CORRECTED: PIC was informed, and picked up and discarded the contaminated produced. Ensure that food packages are in good condition to protect food from potential contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [Pf]]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Observed there was not a sanitizer bucket in the facility when inspector arrived. The PIC made a sanitizer bucket during the inspection. Ensure that there is always a sanitizer bucket in the facility during all hours of operation. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet sanitizer cloth sitting on the counter to the left of the hand sink. The cloth was removed and placed in a sanitizer bucket. Corrected on site.

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
A sanitizer bucket was prepared up front but there was no sanitizing agent in the bucket. The bucket was dumped and sanitizer was added during the inspection. Corrected on site. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
During the inspection, a water leak was observed coming from the overhead air vent above the bread warmer. This leak dripped on the inspector several times during the inspection. The leak is directly over an area where food is transferred. The leak must be repaired to prevent contamination.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed reporting agreement was not available for the employee working at the time of inspection. Form was available and signed during the inspection. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring, and maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under ¶ 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 Employee put on gloves to prepare food for a customer without first washing hands. Handwashing was discussed. Ensure hands are properly washed between tasks/as needed and prior to putting on gloves to handle food.  
Food Employees shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in food preparation including working with exposed food, clean equipment and utensils, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles, prior to putting on gloves, and after engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.
-when switching between working with raw food and working with ready to eat food

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12 Employee was observed washing hands without proper technique. Faucet was shut off prior to dispensing paper towels to dry hands. Proper technique was discussed. Handwashing signage with proper technique was provided for reference.
Food employees shall properly wash their hands with the following procedure: (1) rinse under clean, running warm water; (2) apply soap; (3) rub together vigorously for at least 10 to 15 seconds; (4) thoroughly rinse under clean, running warm water; and (5) immediately follow the cleaning procedure with thorough drying. To avoid recontaminating hands, use a disposable paper towel or similar clean barrier when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a handwashing sink. If possible an elbow or forearm may be used to shut off the faucet and/or touch the handle of the paper towel dispenser to avoid touching handles.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.14 Handwashing sign was not posted at the front service area handwashing sink. Handwashing sign was provided to be posted. 
 A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands shall be provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees and shall be clearly visible to food employees.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Sani-bucket in service area was observed with a concentration below 100ppm quat. Solution was old and not yet changed. Fresh solution was provided at a concentration of 200ppm.
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Use test strips to verify concentration.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-302.12 Food thermometer was not available for use. Provide a food thermometer with a temperature registering range of 0°F-220°F for monitoring the temperature of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. 
Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-204.112 Thermometer was not available in the reachin cooler at the front service area. Ensure all cold holding units have functioning thermometers. 
Cold or hot holding equipment used for TCS food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.
